name: flet-mcp-server
description: MCP server that makes the installed Flet source code the source of truth for AI agents

tools.name: verify_flet_code
tools.description: Verify Flet code against the installed flet: static analysis plus sandboxed execution firing flet's own validators, with line-numbered diagnostics

tools.name: inspect_flet_control
tools.description: Exact, current API for any Flet control from the installed source: properties, types, defaults, events, deprecations, and full class source

tools.name: get_flet_version
tools.description: Which flet version the source tools read, and from where

tools.name: search_flet_source
tools.description: Ranked search across the installed flet source code

tools.name: read_flet_source
tools.description: Read the installed source of a flet module or a single class/function

tools.name: list_flet_api
tools.description: Every public name in the installed flet, grouped by category

tools.name: search_flet_colors
tools.description: Search valid ft.Colors constants including shades

tools.name: get_flet_doc
tools.description: Get raw Markdown for a specific Flet document

tools.name: list_flet_controls
tools.description: List all available Flet UI controls

tools.name: list_official_packages
tools.description: List all official Flet extension packages

tools.name: search_flet_ecosystem
tools.description: Search for verified Flet community packages

tools.name: get_package_details
tools.description: Get version and installation details for a Flet package
